subject: A stylised anatomical knee from a low three-quarter angle against a near-black field, the strap seated below the kneecap, the pale patellar tendon visible below the strap. Exactly as in the start frame.

camera.movement: Completely locked off: no drift, no orbit, no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no cut — one continuous shot from one fixed viewpoint.
camera.framing: Exactly as in the start frame, first frame to last.

motion: One slow knee bend, like stepping down a stair: from the start frame the knee flexes smoothly into the bent pose of the end frame over about three seconds, then holds. The thigh stays in place; only the knee joint bends and the shin swings back beneath it. The strap stays seated below the kneecap and moves only with the leg; its rigid shell never bends, same peaks, same wordmark position and spelling. The pale patellar tendon below the strap stays one clear band from under the kneecap to the top of the shin bone the whole time, moving only with the bend, never sliding, fading or merging into the bone. The faint warmth under the strap dims. One single leg. Everything keeps the exact form, proportion and count it has in the start frame.
lighting: As in the start frame: three-source render lighting, near-black field, no change across the clip.
